name: EMA Small Grants Program
summary: Two small grants for field-based elephant conservation projects in Africa and Asia, open to anyone, with priority for community outreach and capacity-building.

amount.note: Two grants of $3,000 each in the 2026 programme

documents: Letter of support for projects outside the US, if applicable

status.quote: The deadline for the grant application is April 18, 2026 at 11:59pm EST

deadline.quote: The deadline for the grant application is April 18, 2026 at 11:59pm EST

geography.quote: The 2026 EMA Small Grant Program will focus on field-based elephant conservation projects in Africa and Asia.

access.quote: proposals can be submitted to grants@elephantmanagers.com

window.quote: The deadline for the grant application is April 18, 2026 at 11:59pm EST

amount.quote: The EMA Board of Directors will award two grants for $3,000 each.

effort.quote: THE DEADLINE TO SUBMIT IS 11:59PM EST, APRIL 18, 2026.

after_award.quote: Reporting expectations will include a final report with photos/videos, and a mid-term update with photos/videos and a short report for EMA social media posts

documents.quote: For projects implemented outside of the US, include a copy of a recent LETTER OF SUPPORT (no older than two years) from the appropriate local, regional, or national government, wildlife or conservation authority, university, or other agency authorizing project implementation.
